- [Lofi Studio](https://www.youtube.com/@lofistudio_ytb) | | Yearsactive | 2017–present | | Genre | [Music radio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Music_radio "Music radio") | | Subscribers | 15.7 million | | Views | 2.551 billion | | _Last updated:_ 21 March 2026 | | | | Website | [lofigirl.com](https://lofigirl.com/) | **Lofi Girl** (formerly **ChilledCow** until 2021) is a French [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") channel and [music label](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Record_label "Record label") established in 2017. It provides [livestreams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_streams "Live streams") of [lo-fi hip hop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_hip_hop "Lofi hip hop") music 24/7, accompanied by a [Japanese-style animation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anime-influenced_animation "Anime-influenced animation") of a girl studying or relaxing in her bedroom with a cat on the window. ## Format The channel offers several videos and livestreams of [lo-fi music](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lo-fi_music "Lo-fi music") in hip hop style.[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:1-1) The best known video is a live stream of lo-fi music that has run for several years. The music is either released through the ChilledCow label, or used with permission from the artist.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-verge-2)[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-3) The music is always live, preventing YouTube from putting ads that could cut the stream.[\[4\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-4) The playlist is updated fairly frequently.[\[5\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-5) The music broadcast by the channel can be used to practice "deep work".[\[6\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-6)[\[7\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-7)[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-8) According to Emma Winston of the [University of London](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_London "University of London"), the success of the channel comes from the music that "seems familiar to the listener, like a past time gone and fantasized that did not really exist".[\[9\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-9) Fareid El Gafy writes in the _[Washington Square News](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington_Square_News "Washington Square News")_, "Thanks to this playlist, I've cranked out a multitude of essays, study sessions, scripts and rough cuts to the tune of pop culture samples, muted snares and artificial record scratches."[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-10) Lee Taber, Leya Breanna Baltaxe-Admony and Kevin Weatherwax of the [University of California, Santa Cruz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_California,_Santa_Cruz "University of California, Santa Cruz"), showed in a study that [parasocial interactions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parasocial_interaction "Parasocial interaction") can be applied to characters such as the Lofi Girl.[\[11\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-11) ## Mascot [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/3/3e/Lo-Fi_Girl.png)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lo-Fi_Girl.png) The Lofi Girl, studying in winter Lofi Girl streams are accompanied by an animation of a girl studying or relaxing who has come to be known as the Lofi Girl, the Lofi Study Girl,[\[12\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-stdy-12) or the "24/7 lofi hip hop beats" girl[\[13\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-atkinson-13) (officially named [Jade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jade_(given_name) "Jade (given name)")[\[14\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-14)). The channel began using the Lofi Girl for its streams in March 2018.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:0-15) Creator Dimitri Somoguy originally used the character Shizuku Tsukishima from the [Studio Ghibli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Studio_Ghibli "Studio Ghibli") film _[Whisper of the Heart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whisper_of_the_Heart "Whisper of the Heart")_ (1995) as the face of the channel, with footage of her studying or writing used in the streams. When the popularity of the streams ultimately led to the channel being taken down for copyright violations, Somoguy decided to maintain the Ghibli-esque aesthetic but with an original character and put out a call for artists.[\[16\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-cbr-16) One of the artists who responded was [Juan Pablo Machado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juan_Pablo_Machado "Juan Pablo Machado"). Originally from [Colombia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colombia "Colombia"), Machado moved to [Lyon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyon "Lyon") in 2013 to study at the [École Émile-Cohl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89cole_%C3%89mile-Cohl "École Émile-Cohl"), after a stint at the art school of [Bogotá](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bogot%C3%A1 "Bogotá"). In September 2018, during his last year of his master's degree, he decided to respond to a call for tenders received by his school.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:0-15) The tender from ChilledCow called for a "student busy revising for her classes, with [Miyazaki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayao_Miyazaki "Hayao Miyazaki")-esque visuals." Machado, who was not previously familiar with the lo-fi aesthetic, decided to send in his sketches.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:0-15) Several positions were tested for the Lofi Girl, including a lying position, at the end of which she would return to her initial position; this did not carry over into the final product because it took too long to animate.[\[15\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:0-15) The background was originally plain black in order to save animation time, but Machado eventually decided to place [La Croix-Rousse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_Croix-Rousse "La Croix-Rousse") ( [Lyon, France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyon,_France "Lyon, France")) in the window instead.[\[17\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-17) On 11 November 2023, Lofi Girl's [X (formerly Twitter)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitter "Twitter") account posted a shot of her gazing longingly out the window. In a picture posted on 12 November, she pondered a framed photograph. Shortly after, both she and "Synthwave Boy" disappeared from their respective streams, and their streams were replaced by a stream of a snowflake forming over the course of several hours. When the snowflake finished forming, a new animated music video premiered featuring both Lofi Girl and a Synthwave Boy.[\[18\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-18)[\[19\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-19) ## History ### Creation and initial suspensions The YouTube channel "ChilledCow" was created by Dimitri Somoguy[\[20\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-20)[\[21\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-21) on 18 March 2015.[\[22\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-22) ChilledCow began streaming lo-fi hip hop music, branding it as relaxation music for those who are working or studying on 25 February 2017.[\[23\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-newyorktimes-23)[\[24\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-washington-square-news-24) The live stream was taken down by YouTube between July and August 2017 for using footage of the character Shizuku Tsukishima studying from the animated film _[Whisper of the Heart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whisper_of_the_Heart "Whisper of the Heart")_ (1995).[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-verge-2)[\[25\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:2-25) In September 2017, the livestream was reinstated with a custom animation of a girl In February 2020, YouTube briefly removed the channel without explanation, but reinstated it after a public backlash.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-verge-2)[\[27\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-high-nobelity-27)[\[28\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-fader-28)[\[29\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-news.com.au-29) The original live stream that was stopped by the take-down was 13,000 hours long, making it one of the longest videos on YouTube.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-verge-2) ### Renaming and subsequent history [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/99/Lofi_Girl_text_logo_%282021%29.svg/500px-Lofi_Girl_text_logo_%282021%29.svg.png)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lofi_Girl_text_logo_(2021).svg) First logo of Lofi Girl from 2021 to 2024 On 18 March 2021, six years after the creation of the channel, it was announced that the channel would rebrand from _ChilledCow_ to _Lofi Girl_. The YouTube community posts explained how Lofi Girl had become the icon of the channel, and that it would fit as the new channel name.[\[30\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-30)[\[31\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-31) On 2 February 2022, the channel reached the milestone of ten million subscribers. The stream that was on at the time had been running since 22 February 2020, and had over seven million likes. The channel celebrated this by having a party event in the chat.[\[32\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-32) On 10 July 2022, YouTube took down two of the channel's streams ("beats to relax/study to" and "beats to chill/sleep to") after receiving a [Digital Millennium Copyright Act](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_Millennium_Copyright_Act "Digital Millennium Copyright Act") takedown request from [Malaysian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysia "Malaysia") record label [FMC Music Sdn Bhd](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FMC_Music "FMC Music").[\[33\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-TheVerge2022-33) The two streams had nearly 800 million combined views and had been streaming continuously for about 21,000 hours each.[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-BBC-34) YouTube later confirmed that the copyright infringement claims were "abusive" and that the claimant's channel had been terminated. Lofi Girl resumed streaming on 12 July.[\[33\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-TheVerge2022-33) According to a spokesman for [FMC Music](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FMC_Music "FMC Music"), the copyright claims were filed by [hackers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hacker "Hacker") who had gained access to the company's YouTube account.[\[35\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-35) Following the incident, Lofi Girl criticized YouTube for not investigating the claims more thoroughly and for not providing content creators an opportunity to appeal false claims.[\[33\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-TheVerge2022-33)[\[34\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-BBC-34) Beginning on 18 March 2025, Lofi Girl celebrated its tenth anniversary with a week-long anniversary event.[\[36\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-36)[\[37\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-37) On 29 July 2025, the channel broadcast a video showing Lofi Girl closing her computer, on a screen where it says "The End", just before dressing in a ceremonial dress and a graduation cap.[\[38\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-38) A step that sparked strong emotion among his community. However, the character remains well present on his YouTube channel. It was rather a humorous parenthesis for his fans.[\[39\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-39)[\[40\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-40) ## Other projects ### Synthwave channel launch On 11 April 2023, the channel launched a third live stream, "synthwave radio 🌌 - beats to chill/game to", featuring a boy with his pet dog next to him sitting in front of a desktop computer. The extensive teaser campaign accompanied the stream's launch: On 10 April 2023, the animation of the Lofi Girl and her cat disappeared. The audio music stream continued with a still visual background, but without record and track labels. Over the course of 24 hours, the video slowly zoomed in towards the open blue window. On 11 April at 5:00pm UTC, the blue room could be clearly seen, and a new character entered with a small dog and began typing at a computer. The community dubbed the unnamed boy, "Synthwave Boy", "Synth Boy" or just "Lofi Boy".[\[41\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-41)[\[42\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-42)[\[43\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-43)[\[25\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:2-25) The following day, Lofi Girl's YouTube channel uploaded the character's entry animation with the title "Synthwave Launch 🌌 - Lofi Boy POV",[\[44\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-44) confirming the new character's name. As of February 2024, this stream has been inactive for seven months. On 2 July 2023, a new stream was created, and the former removed from the channel. In 2019, a similar YouTube channel named "College Music" partnered with [McCann London](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McCann_London "McCann London"), [Vice Media](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vice_Media "Vice Media"), and [Samaritans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samaritans_(charity) "Samaritans (charity)") to create a [PSA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_service_announcement "Public service announcement") promoting mental health awareness that starred a character similar to Lofi Girl. Titled "what happened to our study girl?", it initially depicted her studying before suddenly having a [stress](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Psychological_stress "Psychological stress")-induced [mental breakdown](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mental_breakdown "Mental breakdown"), and considers committing [suicide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suicide "Suicide") with a knife before ultimately deciding against it. The video ends with a message imploring people struggling with suicidal thoughts to seek help, with the video providing links and numbers of various [hotlines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crisis_hotline "Crisis hotline"). College Music said they were inspired to make the PSA after noticing that an increasing number of users were using the channel's live chat box to talk about the stress they're going through, and that a small number admitted to having suicidal thoughts. McCann [chief creative officer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chief_creative_officer "Chief creative officer") said they went with the partnership because "If students are using these lo-fi channels as chat forums to talk about suicide and stress – then this seemed like the perfect place to offer support".[\[92\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-92)[\[93\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-93) To promote the release of the new [expansion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expansion_pack "Expansion pack") _[Shadowlands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Shadowlands "World of Warcraft: Shadowlands")_, the official YouTube account for [MMORPG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massively_multiplayer_online_role-playing_game "Massively multiplayer online role-playing game") _[World of Warcraft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_of_Warcraft "World of Warcraft")_ posted a _[Warcraft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warcraft "Warcraft")_-themed [parody](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parody "Parody") of Lofi Girl's "Lofi beats to relax/study to" stream.[\[94\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-94) [Youtooz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Youtooz "Youtooz") released a one-foot-tall replica of the lo-fi anime girl, complete with a desk and school supplies.[\[95\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-95) In 2022, [Disney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Walt_Disney_Company "The Walt Disney Company") released a compilation album of lofi remakes of Disney songs. The album was promoted as having been compiled by [Minnie Mouse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minnie_Mouse "Minnie Mouse"), and critics pointed out obvious influences from Lofi Girl.[\[96\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-96)[\[97\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-97) Italian rapper [Tha Supreme](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tha_Supreme "Tha Supreme") released in the summer of 2022 an animated music video for the single _[Siri](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siri_(single)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Siri (single)")\[ [it](https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siri%20(singolo) "it:Siri (singolo)")\]_, featuring a scene of the singer's anime-styled depiction drawn in the same setting and pose of Lofi Girl.[\[98\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-98)[\[99\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-99) In 2022, [Paradox Development Studio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paradox_Development_Studio "Paradox Development Studio") released lofi versions of the soundtracks to _[Crusader Kings 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crusader_Kings_3 "Crusader Kings 3")_ and _[Victoria 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Victoria_3 "Victoria 3")_ on YouTube. Both videos featured parodies of Lofi Girl based on the historical setting of the games.[\[100\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-100) ### In politics Video uploaded by former British prime minister [Boris Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boris_Johnson "Boris Johnson") of his speeches over lo-fi music[\[101\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:3-101)[\[102\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:4-102)[\[103\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:5-103) During the [2019 United Kingdom general election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_United_Kingdom_general_election "2019 United Kingdom general election"), then prime minister [Boris Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boris_Johnson "Boris Johnson") released a video parodying the channel titled "Lo fi boriswave beats to relax/ [get brexit done](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Get_Brexit_Done "Get Brexit Done") to", featuring a picture of Johnson riding a train while his campaign speeches play over lo-fi music.[\[101\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:3-101)[\[102\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:4-102)[\[103\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lofi_Girl#cite_note-:5-103) In 2023, Taiwan presidential frontrunner [Lai Ching-te](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lai_Ching-te "Lai Ching-te") launched a 24-hour lofi beats channel featuring an anime-styled boy studying with his dog. # Top YouTube channels in 2025

![Top YouTube channels in 2025](https://cdnr.escharts.com/uploads/public/694/2b8/ced/6942b8ced0056460980384.jpg)

When looking at YouTube Live channels in 2025, whether they were content creators or organizations, the split was pretty diverse. While religious content continued to find a lot of traction on YouTube, sports broadcasts emerged as the most popular and watched, followed by segments like music and entertainment, each finding its way into the top ten leaderboard by Hours Watched (HW).

_**Note:** The numbers have been _updated to reflect_the entire 2025's stats for these channels._

Streams Charts looks at the top individual and organization channels in this article and ranks them based on the watch hour figures they have posted in 2025. YouTube Gaming channels have not been counted in these rankings, as they constitute a segment and audience base of their own; thus, they will get a separate report.

### Most-watched YouTube streamers in 2025

![Most watched YouTube streamers in 2025](https://cdn.escharts.com/media/quick-upload/2026/01/YTsh-201ebb4695a3a2cc117709ee42f80da6.png?width=685&height=385)

Brazilian YouTube star [Frei Gilson](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCbh6_TmFnAJLI56aAQeD3qw?platform=youtube) enjoyed a fruitful 2025 that saw his year-on-year Hours Watched numbers rise by over 100%. It helped that he was more consistently online this year than in any previous one, with his most active period coming in the first half.

The priest with musical talents hosted a series of early-morning remote masses and services throughout the Christian observance of Lent to great success across the first two quarters of 2025.He followed it with a marathon, 40-day run of rosary prayers and music streams in Q3, growing an already strong audience for his religious livestreaming content much bigger.

A lot of these religious broadcasts also crossed the 1 million Peak Viewers (PV) mark for the first time on his YouTube channel. Having been much less active in October and November, the leader of the Som do Monte ministry has been slowly warming up ahead of what could be another busy couple of weeks come Christmas and New Year's.

Rounding off the podium is the official channel of [Luinny Corporan](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCNI5Sdydy-t5ddkmZ-3HUIA?platform=youtube), a relatively fresh face on our YouTube rankings. The renowned Dominican radio host and influencer has made a name for himself recently by producing content, including interviews, involving major artists across the Hispanic community like Zion, Jay Wheeler, Rochy RD and Ceky Viciny.

He has also become a highly followed entrepreneur thanks to his successful project, La Mansión de Luinny. This popular Dominican reality TV show sees social media stars, singers, and models live together in a mansion, facing challenges and eliminations while being filmed for live streaming platforms, similar to the renowned Big Brother series.

The reality web series has become a major digital entertainment phenomenon in the Dominican Republic, featuring daily drama, fun, and organic content. Its episodes and clips are even available on Instagram, YouTube and other platforms, with high accessibility contributing to the show and its creator's global fame.

Among the other names to make this table were the religious pair of [Pastor Jerry Eze](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCLg4NCAJxhIvD4IRV__LOFg?platform=youtube) and [Bispo Bruno Leonardo](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCVNouUw3d3l5JYVCxhAQXKA?platform=youtube). The former is the convener of the New Season Prophetic Prayers (NSPPD) and Lead Pastor of Streams of Joy International, who is one of Nigeria's most famous influencers. Bruno, meanwhile, is a prominent religious leader and digital evangelist from Brazil, known for his massive online following and impactful prayer sessions.

Indian cricket commentary and analysis channel [Iqbal Sports](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCHxYDy5uZ3tCaM3fn2Y3U-g?platform=youtube), run by Mohammed Iqbal, also finds a place here. He is joined by the official channel of countryman [Pandit Pradeep Ji Mishra Sehore Wale](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCUUIz69kK3Ib5bD4hWLKAwA?platform=youtube), another spiritual speaker and religious exponent whose sermons and hymns on YouTube have become extremely popular in the country.

### Most popular YouTube streamers in 2025

![Most popular YouTube streamers in 2025](https://cdn.escharts.com/media/quick-upload/2025/12/YTsp-e4895fe849fc0d5ec9738c716db88f07.png?width=685&height=385)

Moving to the most popular channels, we see that YouTube has become a dominant platform for sports broadcasts. The genre has banked on a combination of popular content creators like [Fede Vigevani](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCoQm-PeHC-cbJclKJYJ8LzA?platform=youtube) and top influencer-led spectacle events to become a must-see attraction on the red platform.

There's also [Wesley Safadão](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCciJLMuECsXuOyhA4FO48Sg?platform=youtube), another popular Brazilian singer and songwriter, whose live performance at São João 2025, an annual Catholic religious festival, peaked at over 1.2 million viewers. Another African religious figure, [Nathaniel Bassey](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCRe2Ir9wtPk_YQjElam7n2w?platform=youtube), came in the seventh spot, with his inspiring songs and videos accruing the Nigerian Music Minister a massive fan following.

There's also Mexico's fast-rising star, Alana " [alanalarana](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCJOYguJK2uXgXlG-PmPMrmA?platform=youtube)" Flores, popularly known as Alanita. At first a TikTok star, she has made a seamless transition to content creation, with her participation in events like Stream Fighters and La Velada del Año has made her a household name in the LATAM community. She has also used this fame to transition into entrepreneurship, entering the Kings League universe by investing in a team for its Mexico leg, Raniza FC.

### Most-watched YouTube organization channels in 2025

![Most watched YouTube organization channels in 2025](https://cdn.escharts.com/media/quick-upload/2026/01/YToh-661ee9323b06cb9bcd3be6eb43de899b.png?width=685&height=385)

For the second straight year, Brazilian YouTube legend Casimiro " [CazéTV](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCZiYbVptd3PVPf4f6eR6UaQ?platform=youtube)" Miguel finished among the top three spots for the most-watched name in the combined gaming and non-gaming segments on YouTube. His livestreams on the Google-owned platform have helped him secure the second spot in 2025, constituting a jump up of one place from his 2024 ranking.

This year, the star YouTuber, also known as [Casimito](https://streamscharts.com/channels/casimito) from his Twitch channel, continued to focus on sports broadcasts, especially football. He continued to provide coverage of top regional leagues like the Copa Libertadores and the Campeonato Brasileiro while also adding global tournaments like the FIFA Club World Cup 2025, Serie A, Women's Youth Cup 2025, UEFA Europa League, and Ligue 1 to his portfolio.

Moreover, his reputation as a surefire viewership puller helped give him the livestreaming rights to other sports like handball and volleyball. He was, in fact, one of the official channels covering the recently concluded FIVB Volleyball Women's Club World Championship.

[Alofokeradioshow](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCvDvBAOuJIHKWK59duvM0JQ?platform=youtube), the official YouTube channel of Alofoke Media Group, run under the vision of the highly influential Dominican media mogul, producer, and businessman, Santiago "Alofoke" Matias, was the most-watched organization channel this year. The single biggest reason for its surprise appearance in the top spot was La Casa de Alofoke ("The House of Alofoke"), a 24/7 livestream experiment that went viral globally as Latin America's most talked-about reality show.

As has become the norm in the YouTube non-gaming segment recently, a lot of entertainment, news and politics channels made this leaderboard. These organizations come from different nations across the world, including the Philippines, Qatar, Argentina, India and South Korea, regions where these genres continue to dominate the cultural landscape and content broadcast on YouTube.

### Most popular YouTube organization channels in 2025

![Most popular YouTube organization channels in 2025](https://cdn.escharts.com/media/quick-upload/2025/12/YTop-c2c9ff5d2acd7721f6cec392c7214b93.png?width=685&height=385)

When looking at the most popular organization channels, sports events and channels dominated the space.Two top Vietnamese channels, [FPT Bóng Đá Việt](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCljFFNaQoJWeP91Bz4m_3bw?platform=youtube) and [BÓNG ĐÁ VIỆT NAM](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCbkllEQivzBHCkaQX-w4N3Q?platform=youtube), bookended these standings with their coverage of tournaments like the 33rd Southeast Asian Games, the 2024 ASEAN Championship, the 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers and the 2025 ASEAN U-23 Championship.

We also have to mention [Ge TV](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCgCKagVhzGnZcuP9bSMgMCg?platform=youtube), which emerged as a big challenger to Casimito's throne as Brazil's undisputed sports broadcast king. The sports entertainment channel is Brazilian media company Grupo Global's [attempt to expand into live, digital broadcasting of sporting events](https://streamscharts.com/news/2025-copa-libertadores-ge-tv-competing-with-cazetv) in the South American powerhouse nation, and judging by its first few months, the viewership numbers have seen it blow up among Portuguese-speaking audiences.

The official channels of football clubs, including [FC Barcelona](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UC14UlmYlSNiQCBe9Eookf_A?platform=youtube) and [Galatasaray](https://streamscharts.com/channels/UCQpeujIamj2ZOKXZnrxTRhA?platform=youtube), also made this list, with the unveiling of new signings on livestreaming becoming more and more popular among viewers. We also had the prominent UK-based content creator group, Sidemen, in the top ten, helped by the success and fame of their annual charity football matches.

**Lofi Girl** (formerly known as **ChilledCow**) is a French music channel best known for its constant-running live streams that play lo-fi music promoted as being meant for studying, playing video games, or simply relaxing.

The channel's mascot is the Study Girl (commonly referred to as the "Lofi Girl"), an anime-styled girl created by Juan Pablo Machado.[\[1\]](https://lofigirl.fandom.com/wiki/Lofi_Girl_(YouTube_channel)#cite_note-1)[\[2\]](https://lofigirl.fandom.com/wiki/Lofi_Girl_(YouTube_channel)#cite_note-2) The character has become a meme and is often parodied, cosplayed, and redrawn by fans.

In May 2025, the channel celebrated 15 million subscribers.

### Executive Summary: The Evolution of a Digital Icon\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D2&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The Lofi Girl channel, a phenomenon of modern internet culture, has evolved from a simple music stream into a multi-faceted global brand and a sophisticated commercial enterprise. Its history is a compelling case study in successful digital media evolution, marked by strategic pivots, community cultivation, and the meticulous transformation of a simple concept into a powerful intellectual property. Created by Dimitri Somoguy in 2015 under the name "ChilledCow," the channel’s early reliance on copyrighted material proved to be a decisive catalyst, forcing the creation of the now-iconic original character designed by artist Juan Pablo Machado.

This pivot transformed a generic music stream into a unique, ownable brand. The subsequent rebranding in 2021 from "ChilledCow" to "Lofi Girl" solidified the character as the brand’s central icon, positioning it for strategic expansion. Over time, the channel has navigated significant challenges, including multiple, high-profile fraudulent copyright strikes that, rather than hindering its growth, served to galvanize its community and highlight systemic issues within the platforms on which it operates. This journey has seen the brand expand into a "Lofi Universe" with new characters and streams, diversify its revenue through an in-house record label, and engage in high-profile collaborations with major global brands, culminating in the symbolic "graduation" of its main character in 2025. The brand's success is rooted in its ability to provide a consistent, non-intrusive companion for a generation seeking focus and calm in a distracting world, demonstrating a deep understanding of its audience's psychological needs.

### Introduction: The Genesis of a Digital Phenomenon\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D3&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The Lofi Girl channel’s origins can be traced to a creative endeavor by French producer Dimitri Somoguy, who established the YouTube channel "ChilledCow" on 18 March 2015.1 The initial concept was straightforward: to provide a continuous, 24/7 stream of lo-fi hip hop music intended as a backdrop for listeners engaged in work or study.1 This idea was a response to the growing popularity of lo-fi music, a subgenre of downtempo music that had risen to prominence in the early 2010s.

Lo-fi, short for "low fidelity," is characterized by its intentional imperfections, such as vinyl crackle, tape hiss, and distorted audio.3 It is a genre that finds its roots in Japanese hip-hop, with producers like Nujabes mastering the art of blending steady, often looped beats with peaceful instrumentals and sonic "flaws".4 This aesthetic of raw authenticity and introspection resonated with a wide audience and set the stage for the channel's future success.3

To visually accompany the music, Dimitri initially used a looping GIF of the character Shizuku Tsukishima from the 1995 Studio Ghibli film _Whisper of the Heart_.1 The character, depicted studying diligently with headphones, perfectly captured the mood and purpose of the stream. This visual choice was a deliberate nod to the genre's Japanese origins and helped establish a cozy, focused ambiance. However, this early reliance on a copyrighted character would prove to be both a critical turning point and a foundational challenge for the channel.

### The Formative Years: 2015-2017\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D4&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The official history of the channel begins in 2015. On 18 March of that year, Dimitri Somoguy created the YouTube channel "ChilledCow".1 For the first two years, the channel's presence was primarily focused on music curation, but its trajectory was fundamentally altered in 2017.

On 25 February 2017, the channel launched its first continuous, 24/7 live stream of lo-fi hip hop beats.1 This stream, featuring the now-familiar image of the studious anime girl, quickly gained a following. However, the use of the Studio Ghibli character carried an inherent risk. This came to a head between July and August 2017, when YouTube took down the live stream due to a copyright violation claim from the Japanese animation studio.1 The unauthorized use of the character Shizuku Tsukishima was a clear breach of copyright law, and the channel was forced to cease its broadcast.

This setback, rather than ending the channel, became a crucial catalyst for its future. The forced removal of the copyrighted image meant that the channel had to create its own original character to maintain its aesthetic and re-launch the stream. This strategic pivot transformed the brand from a generic music stream using popular imagery to a unique intellectual property with a distinct, recognizable icon. Dimitri put out a public call for artists, seeking a new character that would maintain the "Ghibli-esque" aesthetic.1 By September 2017, the stream was back online with a temporary, custom animation of a girl studying, setting the stage for the creation of the character who would soon become a global icon.1

### The Emergence of a Digital Icon: 2018-2020\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D5&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The pivotal year for the channel's visual identity was 2018. In March, the iconic Lofi Girl character, officially named Jade, made her debut, replacing the temporary animation.2 The character was brought to life by Colombian-French artist Juan Pablo Machado, who responded to the open call for a "student busy revising for her classes, with Miyazaki-esque visuals".2 Machado's design incorporated a real-world element, placing the La Croix-Rousse neighborhood of Lyon, France, in the cityscape visible through the window.2 The new character's animation was clean, minimalist, and perfectly captured the essence of the stream. With this new visual identity, the channel formally launched its main live stream, titled "Lofi hip hop mix - Beats to Relax/Study to," in March.9

The channel continued to grow steadily, but in 2020, it faced a new challenge. In February, YouTube mistakenly terminated the channel, citing a violation of its Terms of Service.10 This incident, though less publicized than the copyright disputes, was an early indicator of the systemic flaws in YouTube's automated moderation system. The channel was quickly reinstated after YouTube acknowledged the error.10 This event was an early signal of the channel's vulnerability to automated platform policies, a problem that would resurface and become a defining part of its narrative. As the world entered global lockdowns due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the channel's significance deepened. Lofi Girl became a "digital sanctuary" and a "safe companion" for millions of students and remote workers who were isolated at home.6 The looped animation and calming beats offered a sense of "body doubling," providing a non-intrusive form of companionship that helped people stay focused and feel less alone.6

### Strategic Rebranding and Global Acclaim: 2021-2022\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D6&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The year 2021 marked a pivotal moment in the channel's brand strategy. On 18 March, six years after its creation, an official announcement was made: the channel would be rebranded from "ChilledCow" to "Lofi Girl".1 The decision, explained in community posts, was based on the recognition that the Lofi Girl character had become the true icon and identity of the channel.2 This strategic move was a masterstroke in brand iconography, as it fully cemented the character's central role and positioned the brand to capitalize on its most recognizable asset. By renaming the channel after the character, the brand was transformed from a content aggregator to a powerful, licensable intellectual property, setting the stage for future collaborations and merchandising that would be built around the character's fame.

This strategic direction proved effective, as the channel continued to achieve major milestones. On 2 February 2022, the Lofi Girl channel reached a significant milestone of 10 million subscribers.1 The stream that was live at the time of the celebration had been running since 22 February 2020 and had accumulated over 7 million likes.1 However, a major crisis emerged just a few months later. In July 2022, the channel's two most popular livestreams, "lofi hip hop radio - beats to relax/study to" and "beats to sleep/chill to," were taken down by YouTube following a series of fraudulent copyright claims filed by a Malaysian company, "FMC Music Sdn Bhd Malaysia".7

The takedown sparked a massive outcry from the community, with fans expressing their dismay and using the hashtag #bringbacklofigirl to demand action.10 This event, which garnered international media attention, became a public flashpoint for a persistent problem on YouTube: the abuse of its automated copyright strike system.10 Within 48 hours, YouTube admitted that the claims were "abusive," terminated the claimant's account, and reinstated the streams, issuing a public apology.7 The Lofi Girl channel, using its immense platform, turned the incident into a form of creator advocacy, publicly urging YouTube to implement better protections and a more robust vetting process for claims, a problem that disproportionately affects smaller creators.10 The incident demonstrated the unequal power dynamics on the platform, where smaller creators often lack the visibility to have their cases resolved and face disincentives to file a counter-notice due to the legal requirements of providing personal information and agreeing to court jurisdiction.15

### The Lofi Universe Expands: 2023\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D7&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

In 2023, the Lofi Girl brand moved beyond its solitary icon to build a multi-character "Lofi Universe." This expansion was heralded by a multi-day, community-engaging teaser campaign in April.16 Viewers of the main stream noticed a series of subtle changes: flickering lights in a window across the street, mysterious Morse code messages, and eventually, the complete disappearance of Lofi Girl from her usual spot.16 This deliberate narrative culminated in the launch of a new livestream, "synthwave radio - beats to chill/game to," featuring a new character unofficially dubbed "Synthwave Boy".2 The new character's aesthetic was a deliberate contrast to Lofi Girl's: his room was bathed in neon light and filled with gaming paraphernalia, and his pet was a dog, while hers was a cat.2

The lore of the Lofi Universe deepened further in November with the release of the channel's first animated music video, "Snowman".2 The video provided a more emotional and introspective glimpse into Lofi Girl's backstory, showing a flashback of her childhood and a brief, intentional encounter with Synthwave Boy.2 This period also marked the beginning of more formalized brand collaborations, with the channel announcing a partnership with The Lego Group in September, which included the release of a Lego-themed music mix and a Lego version of the Lofi Girl.1

### From Digital Companion to Global Brand: 2024-2025\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D8&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The years 2024 and 2025 have solidified Lofi Girl's transition from a digital companion to a formidable global brand and a sought-after commercial partner. This period saw a series of high-profile collaborations with brands from diverse industries, demonstrating the wide-ranging appeal of the Lofi Girl aesthetic.

In 2024, the channel partnered with internet chess site Chess.com to release a video titled "Lofi Girl x Chess.com ♟ - chill beats to play chess to".1 This was followed by a collaboration with the French automobile manufacturer Renault in March to announce their new Renault 5 model.1 The brand continued its expansion into the gaming world by announcing a space on Fortnite in May and a partnership with Sega to celebrate the tenth anniversary of the game

_Alien: Isolation_.1 Perhaps most surprisingly, in July, the brand entered the e-sports world as a main sponsor for the e-sports team Gentle Mates, leading to the creation of a Lofi Girl-themed racing team for a Formula 4 competition.1

The collaborations continued into 2025, with a partnership announced in March with Ubisoft to release _Assassin's Creed Shadows_-themed lofi remixes of the game's songs.1 A monumental cultural moment occurred in August 2025: after nearly eight years of non-stop studying, the Lofi Girl character "graduated".8 This event was a major symbolic milestone that resonated with millions of fans who had used the channel to get through their own academic and professional journeys.8 The "graduation" was a powerful example of a brand leveraging its own history and its audience's emotional connection to create a major media moment and drive engagement. By acknowledging the shared experience of its viewers, the channel created a sense of earned nostalgia and provided a meaningful emotional payoff.

#### The Business of Lo-fi: From Hobby to Label\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D10&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The Lofi Girl channel's success is not solely a matter of content creation; it is a sophisticated business operation. What began as a passion project has evolved into a formidable music enterprise. The in-house label, Lofi Records, was founded in 2019 to manage the music featured on the channel.19 As the channel's popularity surged, particularly during the pandemic, the business faced the complex challenge of managing large volumes of daily sales and streaming data.20

To address this, Lofi Records partnered with LabelWorx, a distribution and royalty accounting solution.20 This partnership allowed Lofi Records to streamline its operations and focus on A&R (Artists and Repertoire) and other brand commitments.20 A key component of this business model is the commitment to providing monthly accounting to its artists, a professional standard that has helped the label expand its presence.20 The diversification of the business model from simple YouTube ad monetization to a multi-channel enterprise is a critical factor in the brand's long-term sustainability. By establishing Lofi Records, the brand created a new revenue stream from streaming services like Spotify and Apple Music, while also capitalizing on merchandise and physical products, such as a wide variety of themed vinyl record albums.18 This move insulated the brand from potential future changes in YouTube's policies and ensured a robust, multi-channel business.

#### The Power of the Character: Art, Psychology, and Community\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D11&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

At the heart of the Lofi Girl phenomenon is the character herself. Her appeal lies in her role as an ideal "study buddy" or "safe companion," a concept that can be analyzed through the lens of parasocial relationships.2 The character provides a non-intrusive companion for solitary activities, and her consistent presence, hunched over her desk with headphones, creates a sense of "body doubling" that helps listeners feel connected and focused.6 The deliberate vagueness of her backstory and the lack of a detailed, pre-written narrative encourages audience projection and co-creation of "lore".6

The channel's success is also deeply tied to the psychological and cognitive benefits of lo-fi music. The genre's slow, gentle tempo has been shown to reduce cortisol levels and induce feelings of relaxation, which can help alleviate stress and anxiety.12 Research suggests that listening to this type of music can even slow a person's heart rate, helping them to focus on the task at hand.12 The looped nature of the beats provides a sense of predictability that helps keep listeners "in the zone," while gentle ambient sounds like rain or a vinyl crackle act as a buffer, drowning out jarring noises and creating a stress-free environment.12 Studies have shown that background music can improve working memory and cognitive performance, with one 2023 study finding that students who listened to lo-fi or classical music performed significantly better on a comprehension and math assessment than those who took the test in silence.12 The lack of lyrics in lo-fi music also makes it less distracting than other genres.21

It is important to clarify a common piece of misinformation found in certain sources, which incorrectly state that the character was created by the YouTuber and artist Juan Pablo Machado, and that the channel's origin can be traced back to a 2013 college project.22 The channel was created by Dimitri Somoguy in 2015, and the Lofi Girl character was designed by Juan Pablo Machado as a commissioned work in 2018.2 The widespread nature of this misinformation highlights the challenge of maintaining an accurate historical record for a brand with such a global and decentralized community.

### Conclusion and Outlook\[ [Sign in to edit](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Flofigirl.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLofi_Girl_%28YouTube_channel%29%3Fveaction%3Dedit%26section%3D12&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit")\]

The history of the Lofi Girl channel is a comprehensive case study in the evolution of digital content and brand building. Its journey, from a niche hobby to a sophisticated media company, was propelled by a series of strategic decisions and a profound connection with its audience. The initial copyright strike from Studio Ghibli, a challenge that could have ended the channel, instead became the catalyst for creating an iconic, ownable character. This intellectual property was then cemented by the deliberate rebranding from "ChilledCow" to "Lofi Girl," a move that fully aligned the brand's identity with its most powerful asset.

The channel’s success is also a testament to its ability to leverage its community. The public outcry following the 2022 fraudulent copyright strike not only restored the streams but also brought critical attention to systemic issues in platform policy. In this instance, Lofi Girl became an inadvertent advocate for creator rights, demonstrating the influence a large, engaged community can wield.

Looking forward, the Lofi Girl brand is poised for continued growth. The expansion into a "Lofi Universe" with characters like Synthwave Boy suggests a long-term strategy of deepening the brand’s lore and exploring new music genres and aesthetics. The increasing number of high-profile collaborations with major corporations indicates that the brand's value is no longer limited to its YouTube presence but is a powerful tool for marketing and cultural resonance across diverse industries. The channel’s history demonstrates that a simple, consistent concept, meticulously nurtured and built upon, can become a cultural phenomenon that transcends its original medium, influencing everything from study habits and mental well-being to brand partnerships and internet culture.
